Why ammonical nitrogen fertilizers are more suited for paddy cultivation? Ø Rice is the only crop which can utilize the ammonical nitrogen. Ø The ammonia in ammonium sulphate is fixed (adsorbed) by the soil immediately after application and it is not leached away like nitrates. Ø Hence, this group of fertilizers may be used in basal application and top dressing.
